$Comment: The Horseman's Breastplate, one of the four plain pieces of his armour the Horseman's Hoard can pay, the Claim players see as his Boss Kill (ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase.json and its hard twin): the black steel he rides in, still warm. A member of the Hallowed set (ZiggfreedCommon/GearSets/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Hallowed.json). Its model is the artist's chest for a player (Items/Hallows_Eve/Horseman_Armor/Breastplates/), his armour with the collar lowered to a mantle round the shoulders, worn here in the plain texture; the Horseman himself keeps the collar chest in Horseman_Armor/. Its icon is drawn from that model by tools/derive_art.py. Its recipe is left out (it is never crafted) and its stats sit a step below the iron breastplate's, the way the Jack Helm sits below the iron helm, with one thing more: DamageBonus_Fire, Ziggfreed's CommonLib's stat for Fire damage the wearer deals, in whole percent points, so a Lantern Bomb or any fire weapon hits 3% harder with it on. Its flaming twin, Hallows_Eve_Flaming_Horseman_Breastplate, is the Hoard's stronger copy, the artist's collar chest for a player, in gold. Light is the ember glow it gives off. An Armor block written here replaces a parent's whole, so the file restates every leaf rather than naming a parent.
